name: search_x_posts
description: Searches recent X/Twitter posts through Xquik by keyword, account, hashtag, or URL with optional result limits.

query.description: Keywords, hashtag, account handle, or post URL to search for.

max_results.description: Maximum number of posts to return (1-50). Defaults to 10.

include_replies.description: Whether replies can appear in the result set. Defaults to true.

language.description: Optional ISO 639-1 language code to prefer in results, e.g. 'en' or 'es'.

since_date.description: Optional earliest post date in YYYY-MM-DD format.
